findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "http" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: due_diligence_person_start, smart_lookup, get_identity_profile, get_email, get_alternate_phones · Private data: find_contacts, get_email · Public sink: due_diligence_person_start, investigate_email, smart_lookup, get_email, get_alternate_phones.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: due_diligence_person_start, smart_lookup, get_identity_profile, get_email, get_alternate_phones · Private data: find_contacts, get_email · Public sink: due_diligence_person_start, investigate_email, smart_lookup, get_email, get_alternate_phones

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
